newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products flat or up, mogas barges at $187.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products flat or up, mogas barges at $187.

text.p: NWE oil products were flat or slightly firmer on Tuesday but trading was slow.
A gasoline barge traded at $187 a tonne for prompt running refinery production but swaps were unchanged around $181.50 for July and August.

Gas oil was up $1 a tonne on the IPE futures but premiums for physical product were unchanged. Barges held at 25 cents below the screen while cargoes of diesel talked $5 over delivered into Rotterdam.
High sulphur heavy fuel was steady after trading at $82 and $82.50 a tonne soon after the open.
